title: Cross-Pipeline Innovation
description: New capabilities unlocked by the shared physics backbone: UnifiedPhysicsVerifierEngine for cross-pipeline consistency checks, CrossPipelineWhatIfEngine for unified material/parameter change analysis, PhysicsAutoCalibrationEngine for Bayesian constant calibration from real cutting data, PipelineConsistencyHookEngine for automatic verification, and CLI integration for all new capabilities.

units.title: Create UnifiedPhysicsVerifierEngine
units.description: Create new engine that runs the same cut through ALL physics paths (SFO, PostProcessor, CNCSimulation, PartGeometry). Compare results: force, power, life, Ra, deflection. Report max divergence %, which path disagrees, and confidence ranking.
acceptance: Engine runs identical cut parameters through SFO, PostProcessor, CNCSimulation, and PartGeometry
Results compared for force, power, life, Ra, and deflection
Report includes max divergence %, disagreeing path, and confidence ranking

units.title: Sanity check mode
units.description: Enable 'sanity check' mode: if all pipelines agree within 5%, report high confidence. Flag specific metrics where divergence exceeds threshold.
acceptance: Sanity check mode returns confidence level based on cross-pipeline agreement
5% threshold for high-confidence designation
Per-metric divergence flagging

units.title: UnifiedPhysicsVerifier tests
units.description: Add 15+ tests covering cross-pipeline verification with various materials, tools, and cutting conditions.
acceptance: 15+ tests pass
Tests cover multiple materials and cutting conditions
Build: 0 errors

units.title: Create CrossPipelineWhatIfEngine
units.description: Create engine that takes a single input and fans out to all relevant engines for unified comparison. Example: 'What if I change material from 6061 to Ti6Al4V?' → instant delta across S/F, forces, cost, cycle time, tool life, feasibility. Leverages shared constants for physically consistent deltas.
acceptance: Single input fans out to all relevant engines
Delta report covers S/F, forces, cost, cycle time, tool life, feasibility
Deltas are physically consistent via shared canonical constants

units.title: CrossPipelineWhatIf tests
units.description: Add 10+ tests covering material changes, tool changes, and parameter variations.
acceptance: 10+ tests pass
Material, tool, and parameter change scenarios covered
Build: 0 errors

units.title: Create PhysicsAutoCalibrationEngine
units.description: Accept actual cutting data (dynamometer force, measured Ra, actual tool life). Bayesian update CANONICAL constants (kc1_1, mc, C, n) per machine+material combo. Integrates with existing AdaptiveCalibrationEngine and SelfLearningCAMEngine.
acceptance: Accepts dynamometer force, measured Ra, and actual tool life as calibration inputs
Bayesian updating of kc1_1, mc, C, n per machine+material combination
Integrates with AdaptiveCalibrationEngine and SelfLearningCAMEngine

units.title: Calibration persistence
units.description: Persist calibrated values in ~/.prism/calibration.json. Each pipeline automatically uses calibrated values when available, falling back to canonical defaults.
acceptance: Calibrated values persisted to ~/.prism/calibration.json
Pipelines prefer calibrated values over defaults when available
Fallback to canonical defaults when no calibration exists

units.title: PhysicsAutoCalibration tests
units.description: Add 15+ tests covering Bayesian updating, persistence, and pipeline integration.
acceptance: 15+ tests pass
Bayesian updating convergence verified
Persistence round-trip tested
Build: 0 errors

units.title: Create PipelineConsistencyHookEngine
units.description: Hookify rule: after any pipeline runs, automatically verify result against UnifiedPhysicsVerifier. Warn if force predictions diverge >10% from canonical. Auto-fire on: print_to_program_full, cnc_simulate, sf_orchestrate, pp_run_full.
acceptance: Hookify rule triggers after pipeline execution
Auto-fires on print_to_program_full, cnc_simulate, sf_orchestrate, pp_run_full
Warns when force predictions diverge >10% from canonical

units.title: PipelineConsistencyHook tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests verifying hook fires correctly and produces appropriate warnings.
acceptance: 5+ tests pass
Hook auto-fire verified for all 4 trigger actions
Warning thresholds tested

units.title: Add 3 CLI commands for QS capabilities
units.description: Add CLI commands: 'prism verify --gcode program.nc' for cross-pipeline consistency check, 'prism what-if --material Ti6Al4V --from aluminum_6061' for unified delta analysis, 'prism calibrate --force 850 --material steel --tool-diameter 12' for live calibration.
acceptance: prism verify command runs cross-pipeline consistency check
prism what-if command runs unified delta analysis
prism calibrate command performs live Bayesian calibration
All 3 commands produce formatted output
